trials.title: A Phase 2a, Randomized, Double-blind, Placebo-controlled Study to Evaluate the Efficacy, Safety, and Pharmacodynamics of MOTS-c (a Mitochondrial-Derived Peptide) in Adults With Prediabetes and Overweight/Obesity
trials.notes: Registered native MOTS-c intervention; the reviewed registry record has no posted results. Registration and planned enrollment do not establish therapeutic efficacy or safety.
